parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that houses all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, holds the internal racks, and ensures the appliance remains stable during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel and covers the front opening of the appliance.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the washing chamber during operation to prevent water leakage and provides access to load and unload dishes.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates downward on hinges to open and close, allowing user access to the interior.
